fields.notes: A vilāsa-pārṣada of Śrī Viśvambhara (Mahāprabhu) in Navadvīpa (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 15, as quoted in «Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). Taken out of the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa #893 (11-11-2026).
A well-known associate of Lord Caitanya while He lived in Nīlācala («Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). Taken out of the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa #893 (11-11-2026).
Of the branch of Narottama Ṭhākura (Prema-vilāsa 20, as quoted in «Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). Taken out of the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa #893 (11-11-2026).
His name is mentioned in Jayānanda's Caitanya-maṅgala (p. 88) («Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). Taken out of the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa #893 (11-11-2026).

Of Nityānanda's branch (Caitanya-caritāmṛta Ādi 11.45, as quoted in «Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). Not the Mahīdhara of the texts of Gaṅgāmātā and Narottama. Taken out of the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa #893 (11-11-2026).

He was Sukeśī in Vraja (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 168, as quoted in «Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). Perhaps one of the other Makaradhvajas (Kara, or Makaradhvaja Paṇḍita = Gopāla Guru #344): the book gives them apart. Taken out of the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa #893 (11-11-2026).
He was Kuraṅgākṣī in Kṛṣṇa-līlā (Vaiṣṇavācāra-darpaṇa, as quoted in «Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). Taken out of the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa #893 (11-11-2026).

A kāyastha of Śrī Caitanya's branch; in Vraja the actor Candramukha (Gaura-gaṇoddeśa-dīpikā 141). Disciple of Rāghava Paṇḍita; his śrīpāṭa was at Pāṇihāṭi, where Rāghava Paṇḍita's temple and samādhi were, but no trace of his own tomb remains («Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). Taken out of the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa #893 (11-11-2026).
He was Mañjumedhā sakhī in Kṛṣṇa-līlā (Vaiṣṇavācāra-darpaṇa, as quoted in «Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). Taken out of the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa #893 (11-11-2026).

He lived in Gujarat and was a disciple of Śrīla Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī (Prema-vilāsa 18, as quoted in «Vaiṣṇava Biographies A-Z»). Taken out of the record of the Mahārāṣṭrian brāhmaṇa #893 (11-11-2026).

pieces.title: Koṭi Bābā, and other bābās met by Ātmātattva dāsa (was in the record of Vaṁśīvaṭa Bābājī)

fields.place: South India (the palace of a former zamindar's family)
fields.notes: A very old yogī of South India. Three generations earlier he had stopped a zamindar from killing an elephant and healed it; since then the family brought him rice and took his instruction every new-moon day, and at last kept him in a small room on the roof of their palace. He came out only on the new-moon day, ate one handful of rice, and gave audience. To Ātmātattva dāsa he said that many had gone to America and done nothing — «Vivekananda went to America and did nothing; you stay with these people, they are doing something» — and was pleased to hear the holy name was being chanted all over the world. Story told by Ātmātattva dāsa; the same text tells of other bābās he met (one whose body kept growing, and the Nāga bābās above Nīlakaṇṭha Mahādeva). Taken out of the record of Vaṁśīvaṭa Bābājī #1879 (11-11-2026).
